Noah: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need concrete owners + deadlines for the DR remediation list. Please reply in one line: owner: action 

Liz: liz: Owner: region-route consistency check CI  Item: add a deploy-time job that diffs routing config and warns on drift. ETA: 10 days.

Carlos: carlos: Owner: snapshot retention & verification. Item: implement post-snapshot integrity check + retention policy doc. ETA: 7 days.

Maya: maya: Owner: restore runbook update + partial-restore steps. Item: add step-by-step for restoring single AZ vs whole region, include estimated RTOs. ETA: 5 days.

Noah: Owner: game day orchestration. Item: run a dry-run failover with cross-team observers, capture timings and surprises. Proposed date: Tue Apr 6 2026. Will confirm by EOD.

Liz: Also noticed recurring pattern: autoscale race causes stale route tables during spikes. I'm adding a short test to simulate burst scaling and validate route reconciliation. ETA: 12 days.

Carlos: For backups: will add metadata that records exact base snapshot id for each incremental chain to speed verification. PR will reference playbook.

Maya: I'll include a checklist for manual restore fallbacks and add a link to the runbook from the alert page.

InfraBot: InfraBot: created calendar event "DR: regional failover dry-run" Tue Apr 6 2026, 09:00-12:00 UTC. Playbook stub: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/dr-dry-run. Invitees: oncall, platform, storage, network.

Noah: Good. One more ask: owners, add a quick risk note (1 sentence) if your item has cross-team dependencies. I'll aggregate and push to the postmortem tracker.

Liz: Risk: needs Platform approval for CI runners in region; may block until next sprint.

Carlos: Risk: snapshot chain verification touches storage API; will need a short maintenance window for testing.

Maya: Risk: runbook dry-run requires reserved staging capacity; Priya on Ops is lining that up.

Noah: Thanks. We'll meet Mon 15:00 UTC for a 15-min status check. Please update the tracker before the call. :white_check_mark:
